title: Animo
description: Animo is a proof-of-concept presentation package for typst in which the content of a slide and its animation are separated. The body of a slide declares what is on it and tags the parts a timeline may address, while the animation argument declares when and how those parts appear, move, scale, change style and change content. One source file compiles to an HTML presentation, a presentation PDF, a handout PDF and handout SVG pages.
